attributes.name: Safe Harbor
attributes.powers: Display this card next to a closed location. While a character is at that location, instead of the first exploration of his turn, he may recharge 1d4+1 random cards from his discard pile. At the start of your turn, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish this card; otherwise, attempt an Arcane 10 check. If you succeed, recharge this card; if you fail, discard it.
